formula: Subject + be + in no position to + base verb + other information

formulas.formula: Subject + be + in no position to + base verb + other information

example: A company that hides its figures is in no position to demand transparency.
exampleZh: 一間隱瞞自身數據的公司，沒有資格要求別人保持透明。

examples.en: A company that hides its figures is in no position to demand transparency.
examples.zh: 一間隱瞞自身數據的公司，沒有資格要求別人保持透明。
examples.highlight: A company that hides its figures is in no position to demand transparency.

rules.zh: 在 be in no position to 後面必須接動詞原形，例如 criticise；不可接現在分詞 criticising。
rules.en: To The manager is in no position to criticise the team. The manager is in no position to criticising the team.

rules.zh: 在 be in no position to 中，be 動詞要配合主語和時態：單數主語用 is 或 was，複數主語用 are 或 were，談論未來則可用 will be。
rules.en: Be I am in no position to... He is in no position to... They are in no position to... She was in no position to... We will be in no position to...

rules.zh: 主語不一定是個人主語也可以是：【a company；a school；a committee；a government；an organisation；a newspaper；a hospital；A newspaper that publishes unverified stories is in no position to accuse others of spreading】 一份刊登未經核實報道的報章，沒有資格指責別人散播謠言。
rules.en: a company a school a committee a government an organisation a newspaper a hospital A newspaper that publishes unverified stories is in no position to accuse others of spreading rumours.

rules.zh: 這不是表示身體所處的位置在這個句型中通常不是指「沒有站在某個位置」。它表示：沒有資格；沒有立場；沒有權力；沒有足夠資料；沒有實際條件。
的語氣通常較強我們目前未能確認結果。 我們根本沒有足夠條件確認結果。 通常較委婉，可以表示暫時未能處理。語氣較強，經常表示完全缺乏資格、立場或必要條件。本課集中練習：【in no position to + base verb】
rules.en: “In no position to” Compare: We are not in a position to confirm the result. We are in no position to confirm the result. Not in a position to In no position to in no position to + base verb

rules.zh: 表示某人沒有資格或條件做某事時，要用 be in no position to；不可直譯成 have no position to。
rules.en: The company has no position to demand transparency. The company is in no position to demand transparency.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚指出某人的過往行為令他失去批評、要求或判斷別人的資格。第二句把原因和判斷連接起來，關係更加清楚。
benefits.en: It explains why someone should not criticise or demand something This structure clearly shows that a person’s previous actions have weakened their right to criticise, demand or judge. Compare: The manager caused the delay. He should not criticise the team. After causing the delay, the manager is in no position to criticise the team.

benefits.zh: 當某人缺乏資料、證據、權力、金錢、時間或其他必要條件時，你可以使用這個句型準確表達「目前無法做某事」。沒有完整報告，我們便無法作出最終決定。
benefits.en: It expresses practical inability precisely You can use it when someone lacks information, evidence, authority, money, time or another necessary condition. Without the full report, we are in no position to make a final decision.

benefits.zh: 你不需要直接說「你沒有權這樣說」，也可以用較冷靜、有控制力的方式表達強烈批評。你沒有資格責怪員工。
benefits.en: It sounds firm without using rude language Instead of directly saying, “You have no right to say that,” this structure allows you to express the criticism in a more controlled way. You are in no position to blame the staff.

benefits.zh: 你可以先交代理由，再清楚提出自己的判斷，讓讀者更容易理解你的邏輯。該機構忽視警告後，沒有資格否認責任。
benefits.en: It helps connect evidence and judgement You can place the reason before the main statement and then present your judgement clearly. Having ignored the warnings, the organisation is in no position to deny responsibility.

benefits.zh: 這個句型適合用於作文、辯論、投訴信、報告及正式討論，尤其適合分析責任、公平、權力、證據和可信程度。
benefits.en: It is useful in essays, debates and formal discussions This structure is useful when discussing responsibility, fairness, authority, evidence and credibility.

benefits.zh: 這些開首方式可以增加句式變化，避免所有句子都以人物或機構名稱開始。
benefits.en: It gives you several ways to organise a sentence You can begin with: After... Without... Because... If... Until... Having... Given... Although...
